tools.name: exchange_rates
tools.description: Get exchange rates blended across providers. Returns the latest rates, rates for one date, or a time series between from and to, optionally downsampled with group. Pass base and quote together to get a single currency pair; omit quote to get rates for quotes or all currencies.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency code, e.g. EUR. Required with quote to get a single pair.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Target currency code for a single pair, e.g. USD. Pass together with base.

parameters.name: quotes
parameters.description: Comma-separated target currency codes, e.g. USD,JPY. Used when quote is not given.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format for historical rates.

parameters.name: from_
parameters.description: Start date of a time series in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date of a time series in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Downsample a time series to weekly or monthly rates.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Restrict rates to specific providers or datasets.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Set to providers to show which providers contributed to each blended rate.

tools.name: provider_exchange_rates
tools.description: Query exchange rates directly from one provider, such as ecb, instead of the blended rates. Returns a single pair when base and quote are given, otherwise rates for quotes or all currencies, for one date or a time series between from and to. Use providers, group or expand as described for exchange_rates.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider key, e.g. ecb. Use the providers tool to find keys.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency code, e.g. EUR. Pass together with quote to get a single pair.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Target currency code for a single pair, e.g. USD. Pass together with base.

parameters.name: quotes
parameters.description: Comma-separated target currency codes, e.g. USD,JPY. Used when quote is not given.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format for historical rates.

parameters.name: from_
parameters.description: Start date of a time series in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date of a time series in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Downsample a time series to weekly or monthly rates.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Restrict rates to specific providers or datasets.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Set to providers to show which providers contributed to each blended rate.

tools.name: currencies
tools.description: Get currency information. With code, returns details and provider coverage for one currency. Without code, lists available currencies with provider coverage; set scope to all to include legacy currencies.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Currency code, e.g. eur. Omit to list all currencies.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Set to all to include legacy currencies in the list. Used only when code is not given.

tools.name: providers
tools.description: Get information about the providers behind the API. Without provider, lists all providers. With provider, returns details and datasets for one provider, such as ecb. Use the returned keys with provider_exchange_rates.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider key, e.g. ecb. Omit to list all providers.
